subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate qualification & extension
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tang <emily.tang@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits / burn-rate qualification & next steps

Hi Emily —

Great to meet you and Tom on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Objective: run a 2–4 week pilot to validate retrieval-augmented generation for customer support workflows and measure per-ticket latency/cost.
- What we need from Acme: rough expected monthly token volume (prompt + completion), target unit economics (target $/1M tokens), and any SLA/region constraints. You mentioned initial spike from 1M–3M tokens/mo with potential to grow to ~15M/mo after Q4.

Questions from our side for pricing/credits qualification: 
1) Confirm expected peak daily tokens and average session length (tokens per request).
2) Confirm target budget range for the pilot (ballpark $/month).
3) Any internal guardrails on per-1M-token cost you’re aiming for (e.g., <$2500 per 1M tokens)?

Pilot credits: we can typically approve an extension of free pilot credits for product evaluation. To speed approval, please reply with the volume/budget details above. If it helps, we can provision a 2-week extension while we finalize the numbers.

Next steps I propose:
- You reply with the token estimates + target $/1M tokens by EOD Monday.
- I’ll loop in my manager (Evelyn) for final credit approval and Dev for any technical pre-provisioning.

I attached a short pilot-extension-form (attached) for signature so we can provision credits quickly.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: pilot-extension-form.pdf

From: Emily Tang <emily.tang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richards <tom.richards@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate qualification & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. Answers below: 

- Estimated monthly tokens (prompt + completion): 2.5M typical, peak ~5M during high support volume.
- Average tokens per request: ~650 tokens (prompt 150, completion 500).
- Target budget for pilot: $4k–$8k for the 4-week evaluation (we’re sensitive to unit cost).
- Target unit economics: ideally <$2,000 per 1M tokens; we can stretch to $2,500 if latency and quality are strong.

On credits: we’ve burned through the initial credits in the first 10 days (happy problem). A 2-week extension would be great — can you confirm approximate token equivalent of the credits you’d provision? For now, we’d like to run a few heavier scenarios (load testing + longer conversations) to validate caching and latency.

I’m attaching a quick internal note that summarizes the use case for procurement. Let me know if you need anything else.

Emily
Emily Tang
Director, Product — Acme Corp.
emily.tang@acme.com
Attachments: acme-pilot-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tang <emily.tang@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate qualification & next steps

Thanks Emily — super helpful. Quick responses and next steps: 

- Based on 2.5M tokens/mo typical and 650 tokens/request, the trial extension we usually provide maps to ~6–8M tokens (sufficient to cover 2 weeks of heavier testing). If you need a specific $ equivalent, we can do $6k in credits which is roughly in the ballpark of what you requested.
- We can provision a 2-week extension immediately once the attached pilot-extension-form is returned signed (I re-attached for convenience).
- Dev will help set up a load test ramp and verify KV/prefix cache settings so you see the right latency numbers under load.

If that works, please: 1) sign and return the form, 2) confirm you’re OK with the $6k credit equivalent (we can adjust up if procurement approves a larger budget). I’ll kick off approval with my manager for the credit provision.

Thanks — I’ve added Logan for any additional product Qs.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: pilot-extension-form.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emily Tang <emily.tang@acme.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate qualification & next steps

Quick note from the SE side — happy to run the load test. A couple of technical checkpoints: 

- Confirm whether you’ll use streaming completions (affects latency + token burn).
- We recommend enabling prefix caching for repeated support prompts; that reduces per-token compute by ~25–40% in our tests.
- I attached a rough usage-estimate.xlsx that maps 2.5M tokens/mo to expected throughput and estimated cost at different $/1M token rates.

If the $6k credit sounds good to procure, I’ll set up a short test plan and a Datadog dashboard for the trial.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: usage-estimate.xlsx
